title: It's finally time to show my game that I showed you guys those Trellis made models for. I feel the game is nearly complete, but I would love to hear what you guys think. This video is the first mission from start to finish, a bit of a tutorial and game intro what to expect. But there's much more.
author: angrylittledev
selftext:
You can try it for free here [https://nerothearchangel.itch.io/underrealm](https://nerothearchangel.itch.io/underrealm) no ads, no in game purchase items, complete main story, not a demo, full game unlocked. Trade, fish, hunt! Do the missions, buy new ships, go deeper, fight pirates, for for factions, fight for yourself. Survive the depths and get filthy rich. 

I hope you guys give it a try and give me a much valued feedback, critique and suggestions.

comments.author: Juzzaman
comments.body: Wow, an A.I assisted game that doesn't look like complete shit! Impressed!

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: Well it's my 5th game, I learned from previous mistakes, plus this one is very different from all the other games I've made so far. This is what about 13k lines of code look like. It's a game with 200 locations, 11 ships, 15 side missions, 20 main missions. Custom made UI, everything in the game that was made by Claude was removed and replaced with decent looking art, some of which I drew myself, others were made with Gemini in a specific style. The 3D models were made in Trellis, so unfortunately they didn't end up all that great, but I like them, for a month of work, solo, it works, there are no glitches as far as I've tested it, no bugs, no performance issues. It's pretty optimized to run in all browsers. Though it's not mobile friendly. Maybe someday. My goal is to polish it a bit more and hopefully able to get it on Steam. But I picked the wrong time, Subnautica 2 is coming out today.. Soo.. yeah... 😃

comments.author: hiimtesto
comments.body: I love the feeling of depth and vastness of the ocean, but I think it might get a bit boring over time. Do you have any plans to diversify the space we move in? Keep up the good work!

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: Never played that game, lemme check it out.

comments.author: Natural-Rich6
comments.body:
Can you give us some technical details?
What engine you use?
How you use the ai without breaking the bank in the game?
How did you made the art?

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: It's an HTML5 game, all code was made with Claude. All in game AI is made by Claude, just programming, no API's or anything like that so there's no extra cost beyond the regular Claude sub that I use. As for the art, I've been an illustrator for about 9y now, so I drew up what I wanted, the concepts for subs and for some creatures, then told Gemini what style I liked and let it mass produce it, same for the UI icons and backgrounds.

comments.author: No_News_3795
comments.body: Personally I want to compliment Trellis for the models (it will certainly improve in the future) and Claude for the creation and management of the game code, I also compliment Gemini for the style used, for the UI and the backgrounds.

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: They thank you very much. It is their honor to receive such high praise m'lord.
